description: Test suite for the evaluateGuess function in a Wordle-like game. It includes tests for correct, present, and absent letter statuses, handling of duplicate letters, case insensitivity, and helper functions for win/lose conditions. The tests dynamically import evaluateGuess from src/game/logic.js and validate its expected behavior.
